{{Quote|Later her father was killed during the assault on the Death Star. I just hope he got a chance to know it was destroyed before his Y-wing was blown up.|A friend of Lyda Skims, speaking about her father|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Doyle Skims''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|assault]] on the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. He was posthumously awarded a medal of valor. His wife was [[Lynn Skims]] with whom he had two children, Alliance operatives [[Athon Skims|Athon]] and [[Lyda Skims|Lyda]].
